prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) brass telescope on a tripod; 2) brass orrery / armillary sphere; 3) lectern with an open book; 4) stone statue of a robed scholar; 5) star-shaped lamp post (unlit glass); 6) marble bench; 7) small stone fountain; 8) clipped topiary bush; 9) stack of books; 10) globe on a stand; 11) bookshelf cart; 12) sundial-shaped star dial; 13) hanging banner with a star emblem (no letters); 14) potted blue flowers; 15) iron gate section.
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt:
Create a single transparent-background sprite sheet for a top-down pixel-art JRPG. EXACTLY 15 separate standalone props, arranged in a regular grid of THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom, with GENEROUS completely empty transparent gutters between sprites. Nothing touches or overlaps; all sprites fully within image borders. Exact grid contents:
Row 1: (1) brass telescope on tripod; (2) brass orrery / armillary sphere; (3) wooden lectern with open book.
Row 2: (4) stone statue of a robed scholar; (5) star-shaped lamp post with UNLIT glass; (6) marble bench.
Row 3: (7) small stone fountain, no luminous effects; (8) neatly clipped topiary bush; (9) small stack of books.
Row 4: (10) globe on a stand; (11) bookshelf cart with books; (12) sundial-shaped star dial.
Row 5: (13) hanging banner with star emblem, absolutely no letters; (14) potted blue flowers; (15) upright iron gate section.
All objects seen from consistent classic three-quarter top-down RPG view: visible top surfaces AND front faces, vertical objects standing upright and base/feet at bottom. Premium modern hi-bit hand-placed 2D pixel art; chunky uniform crisp SQUARE pixels at approximately 8 by 8 final-image pixels each, nearest-neighbor hard edges, no antialiasing, blur, brushwork, photo texture, grain, noise, or checkerboard dithering. Legible 3–10-pixel color clusters, 4–6 shades per material, rich earthy worn lived-in materials; hue-shifted ramps with slightly purple/reddish saturated shadows and warm yellowish highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left ambient illumination like calm overcast evening. Clean base colors ONLY: NO cast shadows, NO contact/drop shadows, NO darkness, NO glow, NO light sources, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. ABSOLUTELY fully transparent background/alpha with nothing underneath or behind props, no floor/ground/tiles, no borders, no grid lines, no captions, no labels, no numbers, no lettering. Scale sprites consistently: smaller items roughly 16–24 art pixels high; larger vertical props appropriately larger. Preserve identifiable distinct silhouettes and spacious balanced grid composition.
